board.name: Idaho State Board of Medicine (Physician Assistant Advisory Committee), Division of Occupational and Professional Licenses

licence.title: Physician Assistant (PA); Graduate Physician Assistant for up to 6 months pending NCCPA exam
licence.renewalDeadline: Licensee's birthday every 2 years: DOPL began moving licences to 2-year birthday renewals on 1 April 2026; existing licensees are assigned to even or odd birth years during the transition

ce.categoryRules: No state hour count or AAPA category split. At renewal the PA attests to current NCCPA certification (or a Board-approved similar certifier); NCCPA's own CME rules then apply.
ce.controlledSubstanceCe: None found in IDAPA 24.33.02 or the Medical Practice Act sections loaded. Federal DEA training is outside state rules.

practice.agreementFilingAndRenewal: Not filed with the Board. Collaboration is set out in facility bylaws or procedures (facilities with credentialing and privileging) or in a written collaborative practice agreement for all other practices; the agreement must be given to the Board on request. No renewal interval in statute or rule.
practice.notes: Agreement must list the parties, each PA's authorized scope, and any monitoring parameters (IDAPA 24.33.02.200.01). A PA may own a practice after 2 years of licensure in any US jurisdiction, with a collaborative practice agreement.

prescribing.separateAuthorityRegistration: Prescribing authority is applied for with the Board (rule refers to a newly licensed PA applying for prescribing authority); no separate renewal found in the current rule.

facts.quote: All physician assistants shall renew their licenses biennially.

facts.value: 2-year licence expiring on the licensee's birthday (transition began 1 April 2026; the former choice of a 1-year or 2-year licence expiring in June is ending; existing licensees phased in by even or odd birth year)
facts.cite: DOPL announcement for Physician Assistants, 10 March 2026
facts.quote: transitioning from the option of 1-year licenses or 2-year licenses in the month of June to 2-year licenses that renew on the licensees' birthdates

facts.value: Ending: licensees who chose a 1-year renewal move to a 2-year renewal at double the fee
facts.cite: DOPL announcement for Physician Assistants, 10 March 2026
facts.quote: If you previously opted for a 1-year renewal, once you move to a 2-year renewal cycle, your licensing fee will double
Prior to renewal of a license physician assistants shall attest to current certification by the National Commission on Certification of Physician Assistants

facts.value: Current NCCPA certification required for licensure
facts.quote: Each applicant must submit proof of current certification by the national commission on certification of physician assistants

facts.value: collaboration (facility bylaws/procedures, or written collaborative practice agreement)
facts.quote: or in a written collaborative practice agreement for all other facilities and practices.

facts.value: Provided to the Board on request; not filed
facts.quote: The collaborative practice agreement shall be provided to the board upon request.

facts.value: Parties; authorized scope of each PA; any monitoring parameters
facts.quote: A collaborative practice agreement, in addition to complying with Section 54-1807A(2), Idaho Code, will contain the following elements

facts.value: Prescribing authority applied for after full licensure
facts.quote: the graduate physician assistant's license will be converted to a permanent license and he may apply for prescribing authority.

facts.value: Yes, Idaho Board of Pharmacy controlled substance registration, renewed every 2 years
facts.quote: prescribes, administers, or conducts research with any controlled substance within this state shall obtain biennially a registration issued by the board
facts.note: Statute says biennial. IDAPA 24.36.01 (Board of Pharmacy) did not load from adminrules.idaho.gov (404); a secondary search summary says pharmacy registrations renew annually by birth month. Renewal interval in the current pharmacy rule not yet verified.

facts.value: Prescribers must also register with the Division for online access to the controlled substances prescription database (PDMP)
facts.quote: Every dispenser and prescriber, except veterinarians, shall also register with the division to obtain online access to the controlled substances prescriptions database.

facts.value: Birthday transition does not change CE requirements
facts.cite: DOPL announcement for Physician Assistants, 10 March 2026
facts.quote: There are no changes to your current Continuing Education requirements.

facts.value: Board FAQ: PA attests to NCCPA certification, which requires 100 CME hours per 2 years
facts.cite: Idaho Board of Medicine PAAC page FAQ
facts.quote: which certification requires a minimum of one hundred (100) hours of continuing medical education over a two-year (2) period.

facts.value: Do not send the agreement unless the Board asks; Board keeps no unrequested copies
facts.cite: Idaho Board of Medicine, FAQ Collaborative Practice
facts.quote: Please do not provide the Board with a copy unless the Board specifically requests it.

facts.value: No limit on PAs per collaborating physician
facts.cite: Idaho Board of Medicine, FAQ Collaborative Practice
facts.quote: The statutes and Board rules do not limit the number of PAs who can collaborate with a single physician.

board.name: Idaho Board of Nursing, Division of Occupational and Professional Licenses

rn.notes: Current IDAPA 24.34.01 lists only the renewal application and fee for RN renewal; no contact hour requirement appears in the current rule text. Idaho is a Nurse Licensure Compact state (Idaho Code 54-1418).

aprn.title: APRN (role: Certified Nurse Practitioner, CNP)
aprn.separateLicenceOrCertificate: Separate APRN licence from the Board of Nursing; a current Idaho RN licence or compact privilege must be maintained
aprn.otherRenewalRequirements: Evidence of participation in a Board-acceptable peer review process at each renewal (Idaho Code 54-1411(2); IDAPA 24.34.01.100.11.c)
aprn.notes: No state contact hour or pharmacology hour count in current IDAPA 24.34.01; competence is shown by national certification plus peer review. Third-party CE vendor pages still cite older hour counts (30 incl. 10 pharmacology, or 15 plus 10); not current rule.

prescribing.separateAuthorityRegistration: No. All APRNs may prescribe and dispense under the APRN licence (IDAPA 24.34.01.200.05.b).
prescribing.controlledSubstanceCe: None found in Idaho statute or rule loaded.

practice.agreementFilingAndRenewal: No collaborative or supervisory agreement required; APRN consults, collaborates and refers as appropriate.

facts.quote: No license shall be valid unless renewed each and every two (2) years on the renewal dates fixed by the board.

facts.value: Rule text: renewal dated not later than 31 August of the renewal year; DOPL is moving nursing licences to 2-year birthday renewals from 1 April 2026
facts.quote: dated not later than August 31 of the appropriate renewal year. All licenses are renewed as prescribed in Section 54-1411, Idaho Code.
facts.note: Nursing release (10 March 2026) confirms 2-year licences moving to birthday expiry; rule text still says 31 August.

facts.value: 0 (renewal requires application and fee only)
facts.quote: The original completed renewal application and renewal fee as prescribed in Section 400 of these rules, are submitted to the Board
The terms and conditions of the nurse licensure compact are hereby enacted in substantially the following form
The advanced practice registered nurse license may be renewed every two (2) years as specified in Section 54-1411, Idaho Code
Maintains a current registered nurse license or privilege to practice in Idaho.
Submits evidence of current APRN certification by a national organization recognized by the Board.

facts.value: Peer review participation required at every renewal
facts.quote: must provide proof, satisfactory to the board, of the applicant's competence to practice by documenting completion of a peer review process.

facts.value: None; prescribing comes with the APRN licence
facts.quote: Prescribing and Dispensing Authorization. All advanced practice registered nurses may prescribe

facts.value: full (no agreement; consult and refer as appropriate)
facts.quote: consult and collaborate with and refer to other health care professionals as appropriate.

facts.value: Yes, Idaho Board of Pharmacy controlled substance registration every 2 years
facts.quote: shall obtain biennially a registration issued by the board in accordance with Idaho law.

facts.value: Nursing licences moving to 2-year licences expiring on the licensee birthday from 1 April 2026; single-year renewal no longer offered
facts.quote: There will no longer be an option for single year renewal. Every licensee will get at least 2 years.

facts.value: APRN who has not practised the minimum required time in the renewal period may be given a temporary licence; the rule states no hour figure
facts.quote: An advanced practice registered nurse who has not practiced the minimum required period of time during the renewal period may be issued a temporary license

facts.value: None in current rule: renewal elements are RN licence or privilege, national certification, and peer review only
facts.quote: Peer Review Process. Provides evidence, satisfactory to the Board, of participation in a peer review process acceptable to the Board.
facts.note: Full text of IDAPA 24.34.01 searched for contact hour, continuing education and pharmacology hour terms: none tied to renewal. CE vendor pages (nursece4less, ceufast) still claim 30 hours with 10 pharmacology; they are stale.

unverified: PA and NP exact expiry during the DOPL birthday transition: the releases say current licensees are phased in by even or odd birth year; the assignment table was not published in the pages loaded. IDAPA 24.34.01.100.02.c still says 31 August and IDAPA 24.33.02.400 still lists an 'Annual License Renewal Fee'.

Idaho Board of Pharmacy controlled substance registration: Idaho Code 37-2716 says biennial; IDAPA 24.36.01 could not be loaded (adminrules.idaho.gov 404, bop.idaho.gov unreachable). A secondary summary says annual renewal by birth month. Renewal interval and date not yet verified.
'full' practice authority for NPs is a classification label; primary sources confirm no agreement requirement and independent prescribing for all APRNs.
Whether PA prescribing authority is a distinct credential that renews separately: rule only says a PA may apply for it; not confirmed.
No state topic mandates found for PAs or nurses: IDAPA 24.33.02 and 24.34.01 were read in full and contain none; Idaho Code Title 54 chapters 14 and 18 were not searched exhaustively.
Federal DEA MATE Act one-time 8 hour training not re-verified here (federal).
verificationNotes: Every researcher url re-loaded with curl (statutes, IDAPA 24.33.02 and 24.34.01 PDFs, both DOPL releases, PAAC page, CP FAQ PDF). All quotes matched. WebSearch budget was exhausted mid-run, so missed-mandate checks relied on full-text reads of the rules.
corrections: ID PA renewalDeadline: researcher cited the Board of Nursing release (-28). The PA release is a separate page (-27, category Physician Assistants); re-cited to it. It shows PA licences previously expired in June with a 1-year or 2-year option.
ID PA singleYearOption: the quote 'There will no longer be an option for single year renewal' is from the nursing release, not the PA release. Replaced with the PA release's own wording.
ID PA: added two board-page facts (CE unchanged by birthday transition; board FAQ states NCCPA requires 100 CME hours per 2 years).
ID PA practice: added board FAQ facts (do not file the agreement unless asked; no physician to PA ratio).
ID CS registration: statute (biennial) confirmed, but flagged that the Board of Pharmacy rule may still set annual renewal; rule not loadable, left in unverified.
ID NP: added the IDAPA 24.34.01.100.03.k practice-time provision the researcher missed (no hour figure is stated, so no number recorded).
ID NP: CE vendor summaries currently claim 30 APRN contact hours incl. 10 pharmacology (researcher said 15+10); the current rule has neither. Recorded the absence as a fact citing 24.34.01.100.11.
